Bill.BriefDescription: Ordering a public information campaign on postpartum depression.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to postpartum depression; adding new sections tochapter 43.121 RCW; and making an appropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.121 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that postpartum depression is a seriouscondition that affects women of all ages, economic status, and racialand ethnic backgrounds. Postpartum depression includes a range ofphysical and emotional changes that many mothers can have following thebirth of a child, which can be treated with medication and counseling.If untreated, however, postpartum depression can lead to furtherdepression, selfdestructive behavior, or even suicide, as well aschild abuse, neglect, or death of the infant or other siblings.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.121 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The council shall conduct a proactive, public information andcommunication outreach campaign concerning the significance, signs, andtreatment of postpartum depression. p. 1 SB 5898 The public information campaign may, within available funds,include production and distribution of a brochure and communication byelectronic media, telephone hotlines, and existing parenting educationevents funded by the council.

The sum of twentyfive thousand dollars, oras much thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated from the generalfund to the children's trust fund for the fiscal year ending June 30,2006, to carry out the purposes of this act.
